summary: Available November 2023 · Allocated Parking · Top Floor Apartment · Close to South Gosforth Metro
description: My Property Box bring to the Lettings market this top floor apartment at the popular Wrendale Court, South Gosforth. Comprising of two double bedrooms, two bathrooms and open plan living room-kitchen. The living room's Juliet balcony provides plenty of natural light into the room, creating a wonderfully light and airy place to be. The property is unfurnished. Conveniently situated less than five minutes walk from South Gosforth Metro with excellent road and rail links to the city centre, Newcastle Airport and the A1M Motorway. Ideally suited to either a couple or pair of sharers. To arrange a viewing, contact MPB today and speak to the Lettings Team.
